title: Why a review round found a blocker: which input was missing, not which gate missed it

cause_meaning.doc_gap: no project doc covers the changed path, or the doc that covers it is out of date
cause_meaning.prompt_gap: the task's goal, scope or completion criteria never stated the requirement that was missed
cause_meaning.convention_gap: the project does hold this convention but it is not written down anywhere
cause_meaning.context_miss: the doc and the rule both existed and were not read, or were read and misunderstood
cause_meaning.logic_error: a plain coding mistake, unrelated to the quality of the inputs
